subject: Hurzeler says he is fully committed to Brighton after Manchester United rumours
title: United considered him. Hurzeler is staying.

lines.vo: Manchester United considered Fabian Hurzeler. Then they hired Pochettino instead.
lines.footage: Hurzeler press conference, close-up, slight smile; cut to Pochettino unveiling clip

lines.vo: Hurzeler has answered the rumours: he is staying at Brighton.
lines.footage: Brighton stadium exterior, Hurzeler walking through the tunnel

lines.vo: He called the outside interest speculation and said he is fully committed. That is polite for no thanks.
lines.footage: Hurzeler press conference clip, hands on the table

lines.vo: Brighton are second in the Premier League. Chairman Tony Bloom says he will fight very hard to keep him. With that table, his argument writes itself.
lines.footage: Brighton goal highlights, crowd celebrating at the Amex

lines.vo: Hurzeler took over in 2024, one of the youngest managers in Premier League history. Second place is quite the reference letter.
lines.footage: Hurzeler first season highlights, sideline shots

lines.vo: So United got Pochettino, and Brighton kept their man. Somebody in Manchester needs a longer shortlist.
lines.footage: Pochettino press conference clip, then Brighton training ground

lines.vo: Want the next story before it breaks? Betting tips, news and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: A round-headed kid holds a clipboard marked Shortlist and crosses out one name, then another, then the whole page. Twist: the only thing left on the table is a Brighton scarf, and it is already wrapped around his neck.
inserts.characters: generic round-headed kid; caricature Hurzeler in a rain jacket

inserts.story: A tiny caricature Hurzeler stands on a Brighton pitch while a tall caricature Pochettino tries to sign him with a pen marked Rumours. The pen is empty. Twist: Hurzeler hands him a pencil and says it is also a no.
inserts.characters: caricature Hurzeler; caricature Pochettino with clipboard; generic referee

inserts.story: A caricature Hurzeler looks along a shelf of trophies, then polishes one empty spot labelled Second place. Twist: it is the only spot with a spotlight on it.

facts_used: Hurzeler dismissed outside interest as rumours and said he is fully committed to Brighton (ESPN, news id 12, espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50540734)
United considered Hurzeler to replace the sacked Michael Carrick before appointing Mauricio Pochettino the previous week (news id 12)
Chairman Tony Bloom said he would fight very hard to keep Hurzeler; Brighton are second in the Premier League (news id 12)
Hurzeler took over at Brighton in 2024 as one of the youngest managers in Premier League history (news id 12, background)
notes: Source row read via read-only SQLite because fdb.py get news crashes on the background field. Chairman quote is paraphrased. Jokes rest on the shortlist, the second-place table and the 2024 start. No injury, health or family material. Inserts use generic stylised characters, no logos or franchise characters.
